orchards.name: Guzelyurt · five crop-year Koroneiki trial
orchards.coordinateNote: Original field study experimental-site description, journal p1775 (PDF1); point only, no orchard boundary.
orchards.elevationNote: 41 m reported for the actual experimental orchard, not a village altitude.
orchards.finding: Young irrigated high-density trial, planted May 2012. Annual Koroneiki fruit and oil harvests were measured over five crop seasons.
orchards.reliabilityNote: Five consecutive crop-year harvest measurements at this lowland irrigated trial point. No demonstrated mountain transfer, mature yield stability or rare-freeze safety. Trees were still developing; no matching local daily extreme-freeze series is reported. Irrigation every five days May–October.

coverageLimit: Six named stations show real regional freeze exposure in January2016. Only Prodromos has a retrieved multiyear daily series. No measured point interpolation or all-range reliability claim is justified. Eastern higher villages and wind/aspect/cold-air pooling still need parcel-local records.

classification.green: Study point with at least five consecutive positive annual harvest values; no area extrapolation or future reliability guarantee.
classification.amber: Exposure/cultivar/management dependent or unresolved climate constraints.
classification.red: Commercial siting guidance exceeded in Cyprus, or major climate constraint. Not a universal lethal boundary.
classification.gray: Annual production not verified, not evidence of unsuitability.
classification.cyprusEnvelope: Native Cyprus DEM >1000 m exceeds handbook general sheltered commercial siting envelope. 300–1000 m remains conditional because cold-wind exposure/shelter is unmeasured. Koroneiki >500 m, Kalamon/Amfissis >600 m exceed their local cultivar guidance. No global altitude rule.
